usage: eventboat [--json] explain --config <pipeline.yaml> [--message f.json] [--topology]

flags:
  -at string
    	entry node for the sample message (default: first source)
  -config string
    	pipeline configuration file
  -json
    	machine-readable output for agents and CI (the global --json, also accepted here)
  -message string
    	sample message JSON file (message-level evaluation)
  -topology
    	render the DAG (mermaid + ASCII) instead of a trace
